name: Pi-Kochi (Infopark Phase II greenfield)
notes: Announced Jul 2019 as Kerala's first Uptime Tier-IV greenfield data centre at Infopark Phase-II, Kakkanad (Kochi), ~6 acres, Rs 400 crore investment. No construction/operational evidence found as of Aug 2026; Pi's flagship certified Tier IV facility is in Amaravati, AP.

name: Pi Datacenters Kochi (Manimala Rd)
notes: Aggregator (DataCenterMap) lists a Pi Datacenters Kochi facility at Manimala Rd, Kochi, ~3 MW. C-grade lead; not corroborated on Pi official pages as of Aug 2026.

name: DTS-NET India Data Center (Cochin)
notes: Fully-owned colocation data centre in Cochin (Kochi) per DataCenterMap aggregator; colocation/managed hosting provider. C-grade aggregator evidence.

name: IxoraDC Cochin (Aabasoft Technologies)
notes: IxoraDC Cochin at Chakolas Heights, Seaport-Airport Rd near Infopark; Kochi-headquartered operator per DataCenterMap aggregator. C-grade aggregator evidence.

name: Stridx Cochin COK01 (MistLayer)
notes: MistLayer Stridx Cochin COK01 data centre listed on DataCenterMap aggregator; no independent operational evidence found. C-grade lead.

name: LuLu IT Twin Towers in-building data centre (SmartCity Kochi)
notes: LuLu Group's IT Twin Towers (SmartCity, Kakkanad, Kochi) inaugurated 28 Jun 2025; 152m/30 floors, ~Rs 1,500 crore. Complex includes an in-building data centre component among amenities; primarily an IT office campus, not a standalone colo DC.

name: Kerala State Data Centre (SDC) - Technopark Phase-1 (Government Cloud)
notes: Official Kerala government cloud / State Data Centre at Technopark Phase-1, Thiruvananthapuram, hosting e-Governance (NeGP) services. Operational per Kerala State IT Mission official page.

name: Kerala 2nd State Data Centre (Thejaswini building, Technopark)
notes: Kerala's 2nd State Data Centre at Thejaswini building, Technopark, reported ready for operation Jan 2012, dedicated to state-sponsored e-governance applications. Weak (blog) source; treat as government SDC capacity in Thiruvananthapuram.
